messages:
pat: opened PR to update sable9b model-card + catalog migration note — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/619
pat: summary: clarify supported variants (sable9b, sable9b-quant-edge), add explicit limits table for longcontext variants, fix embed-shard example, replace curl with SDK v3 snippets, and pin benchmarks to runner commit 2026-07-sableA
leah: can you add a single-sentence "what changed" for release notes? ops wants something pasteable
pat: added: "Catalog: sable9b variant support clarified; long-context limits updated; edge-quant KV eviction behavior noted"
martin: saw the embed-shard math — change floor -> ceil; also remind users tokenization is model-specific and show using /tokenize first
pat: fixed math and added this python sketch:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
counts = [c.tokenize(t) for t in texts]  # model-specific
shard_size = 1500
num_shards = (sum(counts) + shard_size - 1) // shard_size
```
zoe: important: edge-quant for sable9b evicts older KV buckets at different boundaries than classic quant. ops asked for a short forensic note we can paste into support replies
pat: added forensic note: "edge-quant may drop oldest KV buckets at different bucket boundaries vs classic; apps needing stable KV lifetime should pin sable9b-compat or legacy variants"
leah: docs-bot linkcheck flagged a broken benchmarks CSV link earlier — please pin to /benchmarks/sable9b/2026-07-sableA.csv and reference the runner commit in the table caption
pat: updated bench link and caption with commit id. also added a tiny ascii table explaining max_seq vs effective_seq: effective_seq = max_seq - reserved_prefix_tokens
docs-bot: linkcheck: 1 external 404 fixed, 1 unresolved anchor (runtime-router anchor). re-run scheduled on merge
martin: LGTM on content. one request: add a 3-step Dedicated runbook (pin, mirror 1% traffic, open support ticket) so Reserved customers have explicit next steps
pat: added "Dedicated quick runbook" with those three items. will squash and merge after docs-bot green and Zoe verifies SDK snippets locally :rocket:
